scope.constructorBoundary: Relevant original initialization statements only; full role constructors/art/equipment are outside this harness.
scope.fixtureOverrides: After observing constructor fields, velocity is reset to zero; gravity only enabled in gravity mode; wall sets vy=10; native enables ordinary walk with zero gravity.

inputs.scope: Role1..Role5/BaseHero/BaseObject ordinary movement constructor writes only; not full role constructors, skills, equipment, pets, or native movement replay

Role5.runtimeAlias: ToSpear/ToSword only change isSword; they do not rewrite speed, so constructor default remains sword 7/11 unless a new instance is constructed.

frameRate.unit: host frame; movement speed/gravity are per-step values

modernMapping.mappingBoundary: ObjectBaseSprite scaleX=1.2 and original getBottom are evidence inputs; modern HeroMovement width/platform bottom are a projection, not a verified pixel-identical collision root.

rules.velocityUnit: pixels per world host step, not seconds
rules.integration: wall check then x/y integration then gravity; Sprite writes truncate toward zero to 1/20 pixel
rules.coordinate: source rootY = modern feetY - 50; endpoint feetY = source target rootY + 50; quantize source root before projecting feet
rules.ownership: Existing HeroParty movement is sole position owner; no second HP/position state
rules.role5: Default constructor 7/11; toggles do not rewrite speed. Profile6 is an explicit alternate constructor branch, not evidence of a reachable normal spear speed.

acceptance.naturalComparison: Each run satisfies independent timing/order/lifecycle invariants; native timing samples need not equal.
